title: Unit Event — Time to Take Off!

meta.Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD are just about ready to visit the US, where they'll attend the event Taiga and Ken are taking part in. An excited Toya is packing his things when he receives an unexpected message...

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Plaza

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I like the energy they're producing.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can tell that they're excited just based on the way they're singing.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We may not be shouting it out loud, but we're all looking forward to leaping feet-first into a brand new world.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Very nice.
I really like the way they're raising the heat towards the end.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I can't keep my body still from all this excitement!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone must be looking forward to tomorrow very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We set off for the United States tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
What do you think the event Taiga's gonna be in will be like?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's probably going to be a lot different from the festivals that are held in Japan, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We'll want to learn as much as we can while we're over there, including that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hey, learning about events is great and all, but you should also try to do some sightseeing and get some shopping in while you're over there!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, we're not going as tourists.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's right. Yes, this trip overlaps with one of our long holidays, but we're also taking a few days off from school...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, we all promised to go over what we missed and do whatever homework was assigned once we get home.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yikes! That sounds really rough!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it should be worth the trouble.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly! It's not every day that we get to go overseas to see an event like this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I'm also a bit annoyed...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Annoyed? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Because Uncle Taiga is paying for our trip.
He even booked the hotel we're staying at and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, their manager is supposed to chaperone us around, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's awesome!
Why do you find that annoying?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Uncle Taiga said it's only right of him to do, since he's the one who invited us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And sure, he did, but we can't be dependent on him forever, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we're in a race to see who's gonna stand on top of the world first, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Right...
Especially with Ken and Taiga back as a team.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly. It's like we're nowhere near the same level as them right now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Which is why I'm a little annoyed by all this!
It's like we're being told, “Here, I'm giving you a chance, so make the most of it.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Even after RAD BLAST, we were given a lot of help.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's why I wanna grow so much during this trip that we're gonna make their eyes pop out!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And once we've made it big, we're gonna pay back every last cent!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... You're very right. We'll grow, set out into the world and then give back all that they've given us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, you guys! You're going to New York during this trip, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: When you're there, can we pop out from time to time to see what it's like?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah. Like always, just be careful you don't get seen.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
I've been hoping you'd say that ever since Toya told me all about your guys' trip!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: New York's a big place with lots of cool stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. It's one of the biggest cities in the world, and a gathering place for musicians of all kinds to make new music together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And not only is it one of the entertainment capitals of the world, it also holds great influence in the fields of politics, economics and fashion.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! Then, I'm also gonna tag along!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'd like to see it as well.
New York is supposed to be a place of pilgrimage for DJs.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I'm very interested in seeing the neighborhood with all the graffiti I saw in that one magazine!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This may get out of hand quickly if we don't decide who's going to see what beforehand...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree...
Why don't we decide by playing rock paper scissors a little later?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've gone overseas in the past, but that was mostly to see Dad's concerts and some traditional music festivals. Nevertheless, what I heard was beautiful and so different from what I'm used to experiencing normally...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As such, I'm very excited about the music we're going to encounter on this trip.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: So, we'll be waiting for you in the States!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Is it just me, or did they know that we'd be visiting the United States soon...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Many questions still remain...
But we need to deal with what's in front of us right now.)
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I have my passport, plane ticket and wallet...
Which should just leave that plug adapter.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (My clothes and toiletries are all already packed.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now I just need to get the carry-on bag where I'll be storing my valuables sorted and...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? A message?
From who...?
Airport

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We're finally through security and immigration...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I got a little nervous when they checked our bags. I kept wondering what would happen if they took just me aside...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know what you mean! I'm glad that we asked you beforehand about what we are and aren't allowed to bring onto the plane, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. The advice I gave didn't seem like much, but I'm glad that I was able to help.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have about an hour until our plane's scheduled to depart...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. As long as we don't stray too far from our gate, it should be okay for us to take a look around and such.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not seeing anything all that interesting, so why don't we sit down around here somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, alright.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know! If we're all gonna sit, then let's take a look at this guidebook and find places to visit!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? But we already...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm talking about stuff unrelated to music!
The city's gonna be full of amazing cafes and tourist attractions, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know we're not going there to sightsee, but we still should make the most of this opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
We may have some time to stop by a few places while in transit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, like this street...
There's apparently a really famous cafe. Since you like coffee so much, Aoyagi, would you be interested in going?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A cafe? Yes, thank you for the tip.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, we can try checking it out when we take a break or something.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, after we go there...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've only ever gone overseas with my family.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is my first time waiting to board an international flight with such happy company.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
I'm sorry, could you repeat that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Sure.
Are there any places that you'd like to visit?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That I'd like to visit...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Well...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The New York Academy of Music...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Isn't that where...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's where my brother is studying music.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come to think of it, don't you have two brothers? One's a pro, and the other is studying music in New York, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Isn't the New York Academy of Music really famous...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I remember seeing on TV how it's extremely competitive, and produces world-class talent.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's correct.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But why do you wanna go there?
You're not exactly close with your brothers, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I haven't spoken to them in quite some time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
After all, they both live overseas...
And they were certainly not pleased when I told them that I'd be pursuing street music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But last night...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My middle brother sent me a message.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? A message?
From who...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Shuji?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Are you free to talk right now?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He wants to talk over the phone instead of through messages?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But we haven't spoken in so long. Why now...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(There's no point in wondering.
For now, I should reply to his message.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(...!
He's calling.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello?

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <It's been a while, Toya.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it has.

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <Sorry for contacting you out of the blue like this. Mom told me you'll be visiting New York soon.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
She told you?
Is that why you decided to call?

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line:
<...
I was hoping to talk to you in person...>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <But I'm performing in a different state at the moment, so I may not be able to get back while you're still there.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <So, I'm going to take this opportunity to finally tell you...>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <All those years ago, when you came to ask me about how to talk to Dad...>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <I'm sorry for not listening. I'm truly sorry.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But why...?

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <Both Natsuomi and I really respect Dad.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <When you were little, you dreamed of playing the piano like Dad too, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I still remember how desperately I wished to play beautiful music like him.

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <I was the same.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <And in order to achieve that sound, I was willing to endure all those brutal practices.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <So, when you said that you'd be quitting classical music in order to pursue street music...>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <I was absolutely convinced that you'd end up regretting it sooner or later. That you'd end up hating yourself for running away.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line:
<But I've seen your team's videos...
You're called Vivid BAD SQUAD, right?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <You sounded good.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line:
<That's when I realized it.
You didn't run...>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <You found your passion. You're walking your own path in life.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I really appreciate you saying that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, it's true that I began pursuing street music in order to become a thorn in Dad's side.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I expected all of you to call me a coward... It was only natural.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But after that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I found friends I can count on, as well as a dream to pursue.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And through that struggle, I've grown able to face Dad more properly than I could before.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And now, I'm setting out into the world as part of making a greater dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line:
<I see...
You let me know if you ever need anything.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <I'm prepared to give you all the help I can. I'll even tell you about the best restaurants I know...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Shuji.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I glad you're saying all this...

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <I'm also glad...>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <That you haven't given up on music.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your brother seems like a good guy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not getting to meet him during this trip is a bit of a bummer, but I'm all for visiting his school!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. If we have the time, I'd very much like to go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Classical and street music. Our paths may have diverged...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I'm glad I know how he feels now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our gate should be opening soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which means we get to board the plane! This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Come to think of it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Aren't you afraid of heights?
How'd you fly when you were a kid?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that's a really good question...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Not to worry.
All I have to do is keep my eyes shut between takeoff and landing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, that's gonna be over ten hours.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's how I've managed until now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I should be fine... In theory...
New York
Outside the hotel entrance

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: This is it. Please watch your step.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, this hotel's gorgeous...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The entrance alone is so glamorous...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't believe Uncle Taiga booked us such a luxurious hotel.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Please wait here.
I'll be over at the check-in counter.

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You okay, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... I feel much better compared to before...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, you're definitely not as pale as you were on the plane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let us know if you need to take a rest, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for making you all worry about me like this. I was doing fine for most of the flight...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I became curious just before we landed, and ended up opening my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha. I understand why you wanted to take a look.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, actually standing here in the city is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Frankly, I'm moved.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've visited a number of other countries...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Each time I set foot on the soil and see the sights with my own eyes, I feel this same rush of excitement.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Seeing everyone go about their day, all the sounds, their conversations, the atmosphere... They hit you all at once.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, just standing here, I feel like all my senses are being bombarded with all sorts of information.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
Is this what it means to get a feel for the city?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We're really here... In the United States of America.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, I'm so excited now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's head up to our room, put our bags down and check out some of the shops nearby... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's wrong, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Something isn't right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look over at the check-in counter.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The manager and the clerk both look really concerned.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
Do you think there's something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're too far away to hear what they're saying...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh no! The manager put his hands on his head.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I've got a bad feeling about this...
Oh, here he comes.
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, everyone...
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We don't have a reservation?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Yes, I'm incredibly sorry...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Taiga said he'd book his favorite hotel, but he accidentally made a reservation for one month from now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, he used to do stuff like that all the time when I was a kid and we went on trips together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This one time, we were gonna stay at an inn with hot springs, but he ended up booking a campsite deep in the mountains. We had to pitch our own tents and practically live off the land.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're kidding, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I'm serious!
He's always really careless when it comes to these sorts of things...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, would it be possible for us to book some different rooms?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Unfortunately, they're all booked up.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I even checked all the hotels nearby...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Taiga's event is happening soon.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: People from all over the world must be looking forward to seeing it. In other words, we're not alone, and finding a place to stay won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(The sun will be setting in a few hours...
We should probably avoid wandering around after dark.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But what do we do in this situation...?)

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line:
<I see...
You let me know if you ever need anything.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He has his performance to worry about, so I'd rather not bother him.)
A few hours later
New York Academy of Music - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, we wait here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, he should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I'll be excusing myself once I've handed you all over.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Once I've managed to find a hotel for tomorrow onwards, I'll let you all know...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, I'm so glad that we managed to find shelter for tonight!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too! Thank you for doing this, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I didn't do anything...
My brother did all the work.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, we would've been up a creek if you hadn't gotten a hold of your brother.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Would you mind thanking him for us?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not at all. I'll let him know later.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The person coming to get us isn't your brother, is he?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, he's out of state for a performance at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In his message, he said, “Someone I respect very much is coming to get you.”
se_walk_men_001_1
“Ah, there you all are.”
New York Academy of Music - School Gate

“Shuji told me everything.
I'm sure you're all very tired after flying over here from Japan.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I got a part of that!
Shuji's... Your brother, right, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, and he also mentioned our long flight from Japan.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which means this guy is...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I imagine this is the person my brother asked to help us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Nice to meet you. My name is Toya Aoyagi. Thank you very much for helping me and my friends this evening.”
“Toya! I like your name.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He seems very friendly.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He appears to be around the same age as Dad. Also, why does he seem so familiar...?)
“Oh, where are my manners?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“My name is Lloyd Hopper.
I'm a professor here at this school.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Lloyd Hopper...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Where have I heard that name before...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Someone with the same name wrote the score for a movie called “Jazz Cat”, and even performed in it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What...?!
That's that one that won a bunch of big movie awards in the past, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now I remember. One of the songs from that movie became so popular that it was played everywhere you went.

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Oh, are you all familiar with that film?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“Yes.
It was shown in Japan, and has been a popular picture ever since.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“Hehe. I'm glad to hear it.
My friends in Japan have never shared their thoughts with me.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “That's unfortunate to hear...”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Lloyd Hopper is one of the most famous jazz pianists in the world.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Aside from music for movies, one of his albums also gained quite a lot of acclaim for arranging famous classical pieces with modern jazz techniques.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “I'd heard that famous musicians teach at the New York Academy of Music, but I wasn't expecting to meet one here.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “And how do we thank you for coming here yourself like this...?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Haha. Don't worry about any of that! Also, you should all consider yourselves very lucky.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Very lucky?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Actually, I haven't explained what's going on yet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Tonight, we won't be going to a hotel.
We'll be staying at one of the academy's dorms.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was wondering why we were meeting up in front of the gate...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-Wait, that might be okay for Aoyagi since his brother goes here... But is it really okay for the rest of us?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're complete outsiders, you know? Not like we have family members attending here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Apparently, that won't be a problem.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This school allows tourists to stay in certain dorm rooms whenever they're not being occupied.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Some are open at the moment after the student occupants moved out recently. We'll be allowed to stay free of charge given that we agree to clean them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see. That means our timing couldn't have been better.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And all we have to do is clean them? Deal!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I definitely wasn't expecting to end up visiting the New York Academy of Music like this...)

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “You really look just like him, Toya.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Him...? Are you referring to Shuji?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “No, you two do share some similarities.”

rows.Line: (How are they able to do that on the fly...?!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (A quena, an accordion, an erhu and a mandolin.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't believe a session with this combination of instruments sounds so harmonious. Especially since they all originate from different parts of the world.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (For some reason, it feels really easy to sing.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't have to think about what to do next. I know just based on the way they're playing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They must be playing in a way that makes it easier for us to sing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If that's the case...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We gotta kick it up a notch.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (If we're gonna blow the minds of everyone here, then we gotta do better!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is so strange...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (My mind seems to slowly be going blank.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's like all the boundaries between myself and everything else are melting, as everything fills up with this sound...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Like a door slowly opening.)

rows.Speaker: Student Ａ
rows.Line: “Haha. That was an awesome run you just threw in there! Next, I'll...!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I know...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I know exactly what they're going to do next.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We sing and they respond.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's like they're telling us to run as one.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We don't have to think about what's actually correct.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We just have to listen to the music!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah... I'm not sure how else to put it into words besides...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That was...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That was so much fun...!

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Nice performance, everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “I'm astonished. I honestly wasn't expecting your very first session to go quite this well.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Mr. Lloyd...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “What did you think, Toya?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Do you have a better understanding of what Harumichi felt back then?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I know nothing about the students who just did this session with us.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have no idea what their feelings are regarding music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But strangely, one thing is clear...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And that is...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Classical and street music. Our paths may have diverged...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I'm glad I know how he feels now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Somewhere along the way, I think my brain subconsciously divided music up into categories.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Into categories?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“Yes.
Classical music, street music and everything else.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Classical and street music are clearly different from one another. Other genres of music also have their own styles and techniques.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “However...”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “All musicians are likely trying to reach the same goal. At least, that's what I took away from our session just now.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (When my mind went blank during our session, I felt sound coursing through every fiber of my being...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It was the unforgettable sensation of holding a conversation just with music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “I don't know if this is what my dad felt back then, but...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“I see.
You should talk to him about this the next chance you get.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “But I think you're not far off.”

rows.Speaker: Student Ａ
rows.Line: “The way you improvised towards the end there was great!”

rows.Speaker: Student Ｂ
rows.Line: “Wanna play again, you guys? We can try a different song this time!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They're speaking really fast, but I think I get the gist...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “You guys sounded super duper amazing just now!”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Haha. They seem to have taken a liking to all of you.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “You stand to benefit quite a lot from this experience, so I recommend that you all keep at it for a little while longer.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Yes, of course.”

rows.Speaker: Student Ｂ
rows.Line: “Woohoo!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“Excuse me, Mr. Lloyd...
Can I ask you a question?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Yes?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “The first time we met, you said that I reminded you of my dad when he was younger...”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “But do I really look that much like him?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “I mean, no one has ever said that to me before...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Ah, well...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “You both possess cool demeanors and aren't quick to show your emotions.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “But deep down within both of you is that love of music. In that sense, you remind me of him very much.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A cool demeanor and a love of music...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's such a great description of you, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, when he puts it that way, I can see it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Thank you very much, Mr. Lloyd.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Dad, Shuji and everyone here...
Perhaps they're all hoping to discover the same something, along the path known as music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And music is free. Much more free than I ever realized.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which is why I shouldn't limit myself to just classical and street music. I should try to learn about as many different types of music as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Because that may be the key to the street music I wish to make.)
